decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a cheap-to-carry consumable in the core thermoforming range, and the missing website data for 2020 and 2021 shows no clear failure, so keeping the option open still costs little.
A PETG blank is a staple material in established thermoforming workflows with steady lab demand and minimal carrying cost, so abandoning it gains little.

The lacquer had only limited web presence and its value is still unresolved, but as a low-cost consumable linked to digital printing it remains a cheap option to hold, though it is the most likely candidate for pruning.
The contrast spray supports the firm's strategic shift to intraoral scanning and digital workflows, so its option value persists despite the lack of recent website data.
Custom earmolds rely on the firm's core custom-device manufacturing for hearing-care retailers, so carrying cost is low and the line fits its established business.
Custom hearing protection shares the earmold production base and has growth potential in occupational markets, so with demand still uncertain the low-cost option stays open.
